headline: Malware Attack Forces Fukoku to Cease Production Temporarily
body: Fukoku Co., Ltd. has halted numerous production lines due to a severe malware breach affecting its network. This intrusion led to critical systems being deactivated as the company conducts thorough inspections and initiates recovery actions. Fukoku is implementing procedures to restore impacted systems, with plans for an incremental return to operational status. Although details regarding potential ransom requests have not been revealed, this shutdown highlights a major disruption in their manufacturing processes.
